794	def _validate_ledger(
795	    data: object,
796	    snapshots: dict[frozenset[tuple[str, str]], _Snapshot],
797	    default_inputs: dict[str, str] | None,
798	    require_references: bool = True,
799	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]],
800	           dict[str, str], set[str]]:
801	    if not isinstance(data, dict) or set(data.keys()) != set(_ROOT_FIELDS):
802	        raise ValueError("migration coordination ledger root must be an "
803	                         "object with keys version, batches and audit")
804	    if not _is_plain_int(data["version"]) or data["version"] != _VERSION:
805	        raise ValueError("unsupported migration coordination ledger "
806	                         "version")
807	    batches_raw = data["batches"]
808	    audit_raw = data["audit"]
809	    if not isinstance(batches_raw, dict) or not isinstance(audit_raw, list):
810	        raise ValueError("batches must be an object and audit a list")
811	    _check_sorted_keys(batches_raw, "batches")
812	
813	    batches: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
814	    completed: set[str] = set()
815	    # Batches written by the baseline carry no per-item receipts field.
816	    # Their arity is uniform within a batch (a batch is always written as
817	    # one document); a mixed batch is non-canonical. The set lets reads
818	    # reproduce the original bytes while every new commit writes the
819	    # receipts field on every item.
820	    legacy_batches: set[str] = set()
821	    ledger_inputs: dict[str, str] | None = None
822	    for batch_key, batch_raw in batches_raw.items():
823	        if not isinstance(batch_key, str) or not batch_key:
824	            raise ValueError("batch keys must be non-empty strings")
825	        if not isinstance(batch_raw, dict) \
826	                or set(batch_raw.keys()) != set(_BATCH_FIELDS):
827	            raise ValueError("migration batch has invalid fields")
828	        if batch_raw["key"] != batch_key:
829	            raise ValueError("batch key does not match its map key")
830	        owner = batch_raw["owner"]
831	        if not isinstance(owner, str) or not owner:
832	            raise ValueError("batch owner must be a non-empty string")
833	        until = batch_raw["until"]
834	        if not _is_plain_int(until) or until < 1:
835	            raise ValueError("batch until must be a positive integer")
836	        status = batch_raw["status"]
837	        if status not in _BATCH_STATUSES:
838	            raise ValueError("batch status is invalid")
839	        inputs = _validate_inputs(batch_raw["inputs"])
840	        if ledger_inputs is None:
841	            ledger_inputs = inputs
842	        elif inputs != ledger_inputs:
843	            raise ValueError("batches in one coordination ledger must "
844	                             "share one business ledger set")
845	        items_raw = batch_raw["items"]
846	        if not isinstance(items_raw, dict):
847	            raise ValueError("batch items must be an object")
848	        _check_sorted_keys(items_raw, "batch items")
849	
850	        snapshot = snapshots.get(frozenset(inputs.items()))
851	        if require_references and snapshot is None:
852	            raise ValueError("batch inputs do not name the loaded "
853	                             "business snapshot")
854	        item_shapes: set[bool] = set()
855	        items: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
856	        for member_key, item_raw in items_raw.items():
857	            item, item_legacy = _validate_item(
858	                item_raw, member_key,
859	                snapshot if require_references else None,
860	                references=require_references)
861	            item_shapes.add(item_legacy)
862	            items[member_key] = item
863	        if len(item_shapes) > 1:
864	            raise ValueError("a batch must uniformly carry the per-item "
865	                             "receipts field or omit it")
866	        if item_shapes == {True}:
867	            legacy_batches.add(batch_key)
868	        if status == "completed":
869	            if any(item["phase"] not in _ITEM_TERMINAL
870	                   for item in items.values()):
871	                raise ValueError("a completed batch may not hold active "
872	                                 "items")
873	            completed.add(batch_key)
874	        batches[batch_key] = {
875	            "key": batch_key,
876	            "owner": owner,
877	            "until": until,
878	            "status": status,
879	            "inputs": inputs,
880	            "items": items,
881	        }
882	
883	    audit: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
884	    seen_events: set[str] = set()
885	    for event_raw in audit_raw:
886	        if not isinstance(event_raw, dict) \
887	                or set(event_raw.keys()) != set(_EVENT_FIELDS):
888	            raise ValueError("migration audit event has invalid fields")
889	        event_key = event_raw["key"]
890	        if not isinstance(event_key, str) or not event_key:
891	            raise ValueError("migration audit event key must be a "
892	                             "non-empty string")
893	        # The audit is an append-only log in the real order batches
894	        # completed: the physical position carries the order, so events
895	        # need not be -- and must not be re-sorted by -- batch key. Only
896	        # duplication is illegal here.
897	        if event_key in seen_events:
898	            raise ValueError("migration audit keys must be unique")
899	        seen_events.add(event_key)
900	        at = event_raw["at"]
901	        if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
902	            raise ValueError("migration audit moment must be a non-"
903	                             "boolean non-negative integer")
904	        batch = batches.get(event_key)
905	        if batch is None or batch["status"] != "completed":
906	            raise ValueError("migration audit event must reference a "
907	                             "completed batch")
908	        # Compare against the batch in its on-disk arity: a baseline
909	        # batch's audit snapshot predates the per-item receipts field,
910	        # whose values are derived on load.
911	        expected_event_batch = _canonical_batch(
912	            batch, legacy=event_key in legacy_batches)
913	        if event_raw["batch"] != expected_event_batch:
914	            raise ValueError("migration audit event batch does not match "
915	                             "its batch")
916	        audit.append({"key": event_key, "at": at,
917	                      "batch": copy.deepcopy(batch)})
918	
919	    # Exactly one closing event per completed batch, none for a batch
920	    # still running.
921	    if seen_events != completed:
922	        raise ValueError("migration audit events must match the completed "
923	                         "batches")
924	    if ledger_inputs is None:
925	        if default_inputs is None:
926	            raise ValueError("a migration coordination ledger must hold "
927	                             "at least one batch")
928	        ledger_inputs = default_inputs
929	    return batches, audit, ledger_inputs, legacy_batches

949	def _canonical_bytes(
950	    batches: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
951	    audit: list[dict[str, Any]],
952	    legacy_batches: set[str] | None = None,
953	) -> bytes:
954	    # Compact UTF-8 JSON, non-ASCII written through, sections in their
955	    # fixed field order, batches and their items code-point sorted and
956	    # the audit appended in the physical order in which the batches
957	    # actually completed (never re-sorted by batch key), terminated by
958	    # exactly one newline. Baseline batches without the per-item
959	    # receipts field are reproduced field-for-field; every batch a run
960	    # (re)writes carries that field.
961	    legacy_batches = legacy_batches or set()
962	    payload = {
963	        "version": _VERSION,
964	        "batches": {key: _canonical_batch(
965	                        batches[key], legacy=key in legacy_batches)
966	                    for key in sorted(batches)},
967	        "audit": [{"key": event["key"], "at": event["at"],
968	                   "batch": _canonical_batch(
969	                       event["batch"],
970	                       legacy=event["key"] in legacy_batches)}
971	                  for event in audit],
972	    }
973	    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"),
974	                      allow_nan=False) + "\n"
975	    return text.encode("utf-8")

978	def _parse_coordination_bytes(
979	    realpath: str,
980	    raw: bytes,
981	    snapshots: dict[frozenset[tuple[str, str]], _Snapshot],
982	    default_inputs: dict[str, str] | None = None,
983	    require_references: bool = True,
984	) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]],
985	           dict[str, str], set[str]]:
986	    try:
987	        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
988	    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
989	        raise ValueError(
990	            f"migration coordination ledger {realpath!r} is not valid "
991	            "UTF-8") from exc
992	    try:
993	        # Negative-zero and non-finite literals are format errors.
994	        data = finite_loads(text)
995	    except ValueError as exc:
996	        raise ValueError(
997	            f"migration coordination ledger {realpath!r} is not valid "
998	            "JSON") from exc
999	    batches, audit, inputs, legacy_batches = _validate_ledger(
1000	        data, snapshots, default_inputs,
1001	        require_references=require_references)
1002	    if raw != _canonical_bytes(batches, audit, legacy_batches):
1003	        raise ValueError(

1005	            "canonical compact form")

1034	def _validate_receipts(receipts: object) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
1035	    if receipts is None:
1036	        return {}
1037	    if not isinstance(receipts, dict):
1038	        raise ValueError("receipts must be an object keyed by job id")
1039	    checked: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
1040	    for job_id, raw in receipts.items():
1041	        if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not job_id:
1042	            raise ValueError("receipt job ids must be non-empty strings")
1043	        if not isinstance(raw, dict) \
1044	                or set(raw.keys()) != {"step", "result", "receipt", "at"}:
1045	            raise ValueError("receipt must carry step, result, receipt and "
1046	                             "at")
1047	        step = raw["step"]
1048	        if step not in _STEPS:
1049	            raise ValueError("receipt step must be copy or switch")
1050	        result = raw["result"]
1051	        if result not in ("succeeded", "failed"):
1052	            raise ValueError("receipt result must be succeeded or failed")
1053	        receipt = raw["receipt"]
1054	        if not isinstance(receipt, str) or not receipt:
1055	            raise ValueError("receipt text must be a non-empty string")
1056	        at = raw["at"]
1057	        if not _is_plain_int(at) or at < 0:
1058	            raise ValueError("receipt at must be a non-boolean non-"
1059	                             "negative integer")
1060	        checked[job_id] = {"step": step, "result": result,
1061	                           "receipt": receipt, "at": at}
1062	    return checked

1070	def _lease_end_for(job: dict[str, Any], at: int, lease: int) -> int:
1071	    # A plan this batch starts takes one coordination-lease window,
1072	    # capped at the job deadline the claim may not pass.
1073	    return min(at + lease, job["deadline"])

1076	def _build_members(
1077	    snapshot: _Snapshot,
1078	    batch_key: str,
1079	    owner: str,
1080	    now: int,
1081	    lease: int,
1082	    excluded: set[str],
1083	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
1084	    # Fix the membership from one complete snapshot: accepted jobs that
1085	    # already hold a trade and whose booking is not yet finished -- a
1086	    # succeeded dispatch or a completed execution plan never becomes a
1087	    # member again -- minus jobs another still-open batch already
1088	    # drives, ordered by job id. The stage each member starts in is
1089	    # fixed here; only its downstream requests advance later.
1090	    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1091	    for job_id in sorted(snapshot.accepted):
1092	        if snapshot.cleared.get(job_id) is None or job_id in excluded:
1093	            continue
1094	        decision = snapshot.decisions.get(job_id)
1095	        exec_states = {plan["state"]
1096	                       for plan in snapshot.exec_plans.get(job_id, {}).values()}
1097	        if (decision is not None and decision["state"] == "succeeded") \
1098	                or "completed" in exec_states:
1099	            # A completed dispatch or execution is a finished booking:
1100	            # it is fixed by no batch, now or on any later scan.
1101	            continue
1102	        binding = snapshot.current_binding(job_id)
1103	        own_plan_key = _plan_key_for(batch_key, job_id)
1104	        rooted = snapshot.rooted_plans(job_id, binding)
1105	        active = next((plan for _ref, plan in rooted
1106	                       if plan["state"] == "active"), None)
1107	        if active is not None:
1108	            # A migration round for the current binding is already in
1109	            # flight: drive it with receipts, waiting or recovery.
1110	            active_ref = next(ref for ref, plan in rooted if plan is active)
1111	            members.append({
1112	                "job_id": job_id,
1113	                "plan_key": active_ref,
1114	                "phase": "active",
1115	                "request_key": active_ref,
1116	                "lease": active["lease_end"],
1117	                "error": None,
1118	                "snapshot": copy.deepcopy(active),
1119	                # The plan may already hold recorded step receipts; the
1120	                # first snapshot keeps them verbatim, including non-ASCII
1121	                # credentials, instead of reducing the member to a stage.
1122	                "receipts": copy.deepcopy(active["steps"]),
1123	            })
1124	            continue
1125	        terminal = next((plan for _ref, plan in reversed(rooted)
1126	                         if plan["state"] in _PLAN_TERMINAL
1127	                         and not any(record["plan_key"] == _ref
1128	                                     for record in
1129	                                     snapshot.settlements.values()
1130	                                     if record["job_id"] == job_id)), None)
1131	        if terminal is not None:
1132	            # A terminal plan rooted at the current binding has not been
1133	            # settled: enter settlement straight away; reservation and
1134	            # claim are history and are never repeated.
1135	            terminal_ref = next(
1136	                ref for ref, plan in rooted
1137	                if plan is terminal and not any(
1138	                    record["job_id"] == job_id
1139	                    and record["plan_key"] == ref
1140	                    for record in snapshot.settlements.values()))
1141	            settle_at = max(now, snapshot.terminal_moment(terminal,
1142	                                                          terminal_ref))
1143	            settle_key, settle_at = snapshot.settle_request(
1144	                job_id, terminal_ref, settle_at,
1145	                _settle_key_for(terminal_ref))
1146	            members.append({
1147	                "job_id": job_id,
1148	                "plan_key": terminal_ref,
1149	                "phase": "settling",
1150	                "request_key": settle_key,
1151	                "lease": terminal["lease_end"],
1152	                "error": None,
1153	                "snapshot": _marker("settle", plan_key=terminal_ref,
1154	                                    at=settle_at),
1155	                "receipts": copy.deepcopy(terminal["steps"]),
1156	            })
1157	            continue
1158	        unclaimed = snapshot.unclaimed_rooted_intent(job_id, binding)
1159	        if unclaimed is not None:
1160	            # A current-round reservation exists but has not been
1161	            # claimed: claim it under the batch owner for one lease
1162	            # window.
1163	            _ref, intent = unclaimed
1164	            lease_end = _lease_end_for(snapshot.accepted[job_id], now, lease)
1165	            members.append({
1166	                "job_id": job_id,
1167	                "plan_key": own_plan_key,
1168	                "phase": "claimed",
1169	                "request_key": own_plan_key,
1170	                "lease": lease_end,
1171	                "error": None,
1172	                "snapshot": _marker("start", owner=owner, lease_end=lease_end,
1173	                                    at=now),
1174	                "receipts": [],
1175	            })
1176	            continue
1177	        decision = snapshot.decisions.get(job_id)
1178	        exec_states = {plan["state"]
1179	                       for plan in snapshot.exec_plans.get(job_id, {}).values()}
1180	        if decision is not None and (
1181	                decision["state"] in ("succeeded", "claimed")
1182	                or exec_states & {"completed", "active"}) \
1183	                or now > snapshot.accepted[job_id]["deadline"]:
1184	            # No current migration round and the booking itself is
1185	            # finished or in flight through the baseline layers, or the
1186	            # deadline has already passed so no migration is possible:
1187	            # the job simply stays on its current binding.
1188	            members.append({
1189	                "job_id": job_id,
1190	                "plan_key": None,
1191	                "phase": "kept",
1192	                "request_key": _stable_key(batch_key, job_id, "keep"),
1193	                "lease": None,
1194	                "error": None,
1195	                "snapshot": binding,
1196	                "receipts": [],
1197	            })
1198	            continue
1199	        # Otherwise the batch judges the round itself: the evaluate
1200	        # call persisted below decides keep or migrate at the batch
1201	        # moment, rooted at the latest completed binding.
1202	        members.append({
1203	            "job_id": job_id,
1204	            "plan_key": own_plan_key,
1205	            "phase": "evaluating",
1206	            "request_key": _stable_key(batch_key, job_id, "evaluate"),
1207	            "lease": None,
1208	            "error": None,
1209	            "snapshot": _marker("evaluate", at=now),
1210	            "receipts": [],
1211	        })
1212	    return members

1228	def _is_business_error(exc: BaseException) -> bool:
1229	    # The downstream interfaces' refusal vocabulary is business state
1230	    # and fails just the member; locking and I/O failures surface as
1231	    # OSError and abort the whole run.

1233	        exc, (ValueError, KeyError, LookupError, PermissionError,

1242	def run(
1243	    jobs: str,
1244	    supply: str,
1245	    signals: str,
1246	    trades: str,
1247	    dispatch: str,
1248	    execution: str,
1249	    advice: str,
1250	    ledger: str,
1251	    settlements: str,
1252	    coordination: str,
1253	    owner: str,
1254	    key: str,
1255	    now: int,
1256	    lease: int,
1257	    receipts: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
1258	) -> tuple[dict[str, object], bool]:
1259	    """Coordinate one persistent batch of migrations idempotently.
1260	
1261	    The nine business ledger paths (acceptance, supply, signals,
1262	    clearing, dispatch, execution, advice, migration intent and
1263	    settlement), the coordination ledger path, ``owner`` and ``key``
1264	    must be non-empty strings and the ten paths must resolve to distinct
1265	    real locations; ``now`` must be a non-boolean non-negative integer
1266	    moment and ``lease`` a non-boolean positive integer coordination
1267	    lease (also the claim-lease window of plans this batch starts,
1268	    capped at the job deadline). ``receipts`` is an optional job-keyed
1269	    map; each receipt carries ``step`` (``copy`` or ``switch``),
1270	    ``result`` (``succeeded`` or ``failed``), a non-empty ``receipt``
1271	    string and a non-negative ``at`` moment. Any violation raises
1272	    ``ValueError`` before a business file is read.
1273	
1274	    The first call for ``key`` fixes the members from one complete
1275	    snapshot and persists them in job-id order; an empty scan still
1276	    commits a completed batch with its audit event. Each downstream
1277	    action and its parameters are durably saved before the call and the
1278	    member advances only on success, so crash re-entry replays the
1279	    original request and a completed phase is never redone. A member's
1280	    business exception saves the public exception class and fails that
1281	    member; the other members continue. The same key with a changed
1282	    ledger set raises ``ValueError`` and an active batch owned by another
1283	    caller raises ``PermissionError`` until the lease has strictly
1284	    expired.
1285	
1286	    Returns ``(batch, created)`` -- a fixed-order copy and the
1287	    first-creation flag. Missing input files or the coordination ledger
1288	    parent raise ``FileNotFoundError``; invalid arguments, receipts,
1289	    structure, ordering, references or non-canonical bytes raise
1290	    ``ValueError``; other locking or I/O failures raise ``OSError``.
1291	    """
1292	    for value in (jobs, supply, signals, trades, dispatch, execution,
1293	                  advice, ledger, settlements, coordination, owner, key):
1294	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
1295	            raise ValueError("the ten paths, owner and key must be "
1296	                             "non-empty strings")
1297	    if not _is_plain_int(now) or now < 0:
1298	        raise ValueError("now must be a non-boolean non-negative integer")
1299	    if not _is_plain_int(lease) or lease < 1:
1300	        raise ValueError("lease must be a non-boolean positive integer")
1301	    checked_receipts = _validate_receipts(receipts)
1302	
1303	    reals = {
1304	        "jobs": os.path.realpath(jobs),
1305	        "supply": os.path.realpath(supply),
1306	        "signals": os.path.realpath(signals),
1307	        "trades": os.path.realpath(trades),
1308	        "dispatch": os.path.realpath(dispatch),
1309	        "execution": os.path.realpath(execution),
1310	        "advice": os.path.realpath(advice),
1311	        "ledger": os.path.realpath(ledger),
1312	        "settlements": os.path.realpath(settlements),
1313	        "coordination": os.path.realpath(coordination),
1314	    }
1315	    if len(set(reals.values())) != 10:
1316	        raise ValueError("the ten paths must be distinct real paths")
1317	    coordination_real = reals["coordination"]
1318	    paths7 = tuple(reals[name] for name in
1319	                   ("jobs", "supply", "signals", "trades", "dispatch",
1320	                    "execution", "advice"))
1321	    paths8 = paths7 + (reals["ledger"],)
1322	
1323	    store = _get_store(coordination)
1324	    with store.lock:
1325	        # Lock order is fixed for every process: the coordination
1326	        # ledger's exclusive lock first -- the one lock that serializes
1327	        # whole batches and that only this module takes -- and then the
1328	        # nine business ledgers' shared locks in resolved real-path
1329	        # order. The shared locks are released around each downstream
1330	        # call (apply/start/record/recover/settle take the intent and
1331	        # settlement ledgers' own exclusive locks themselves, and
1332	        # discover the settlement ledger beside the snapshots), exactly
1333	        # as execution_sync releases its inputs before dispatching.
1334	        held: list[Any] = []
1335	
1336	        def acquire_inputs() -> None:
1337	            for real in sorted(set(reals[name] for name in _INPUT_NAMES)):
1338	                manager = _lock(real, shared=True)
1339	                manager.__enter__()
1340	                held.append(manager)
1341	
1342	        def release_inputs() -> None:
1343	            while held:
1344	                manager = held.pop()
1345	                with contextlib.suppress(BaseException):
1346	                    manager.__exit__(None, None, None)
1347	
1348	        with _lock(coordination_real):
1349	            acquire_inputs()
1350	            snapshot = _Snapshot(reals)
1351	            try:
1352	                snapshot_map = {frozenset(snapshot.input_map.items()):
1353	                                snapshot}
1354	                batches, audit_events, _ledger_inputs, old_bytes, \
1355	                    legacy_batches = _load_coordination(
1356	                        coordination_real, snapshot_map, snapshot.input_map)
1357	
1358	                batch = batches.get(key)
1359	                created = batch is None
1360	                if created:
1361	                    excluded = {
1362	                        member
1363	                        for existing in batches.values()
1364	                        if existing["status"] == "pending"
1365	                        for member in existing["items"]
1366	                    }
1367	                    members = _build_members(
1368	                        snapshot, key, owner, now, lease, excluded)
1369	                    # A receipt only matches a member that is or becomes
1370	                    # an active migration plan; a keep or settling member
1371	                    # cannot consume one.
1372	                    for receipt_job in checked_receipts:
1373	                        member = next(
1374	                            (candidate for candidate in members
1375	                             if candidate["job_id"] == receipt_job), None)
1376	                        if member is None \
1377	                                or member["phase"] not in (
1378	                                    "evaluating", "reserved", "claimed",
1379	                                    "active"):
1380	                            raise ValueError("receipt does not match an "
1381	                                             "active migration member")
1382	                    batch = {
1383	                        "key": key,
1384	                        "owner": owner,
1385	                        "until": now + lease,
1386	                        "status": "pending",
1387	                        "inputs": snapshot.input_map,
1388	                        "items": {member["job_id"]:
1389	                                      dict(member, receipts=list(
1390	                                          member.get("receipts", ())))
1391	                                  for member in members},
1392	                    }
1393	                    batches[key] = batch
1394	                else:
1395	                    if batch["inputs"] != snapshot.input_map:
1396	                        raise ValueError("batch key was already used with "
1397	                                         "a different business ledger set")
